component.name: AnimatedImageXmlChild
component.script:
sub init() m.a = m.top.findNode("a") print "PROBE|041|animatedimage-xmlattr|before-observe|state=" + safeState() m.a.observeField("state", "onState") end sub
' Same theory as MediaTaskProbe's onPosterStatus/PosterXmlChild's onStatus: nothing here is ' assumed to still be present in `m` -- diagnostic-first, every risky access guarded. sub onState() print "PROBE|042a|animatedimage-xmlattr|observer|m-count=" + m.count().toStr() print "PROBE|042b|animatedimage-xmlattr|observer|has-a=" + m.DoesExist("a").toStr() print "PROBE|042c|animatedimage-xmlattr|observer|has-top=" + m.DoesExist("top").toStr() state = "no-a-in-m" if m.DoesExist("a") state = safeState() end if try m.top.observedCount = m.top.observedCount + 1 m.top.stateAtObserve = state catch e print "PROBE|042d|animatedimage-xmlattr|observer|set-top-fields|CRASH:" + e.message end try print "PROBE|042|animatedimage-xmlattr|observer|state=" + state end sub
function safeState() as string result = "?" try result = m.a.state catch e result = "CRASH:" + e.message end try return result end function
